```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: hide
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
# GSEA
# Get full GSEA table
gsea_table_file <- dir(
  "analysis_gsea",
  pattern = "^.*\\.gsea\\.full\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]
gsea_table <- read_csv(gsea_table_file)

# Get cohort ID
cohort_id <- gsub("^analysis_gsea\\/(.*)\\.gsea\\.full\\.csv$", "\\1", gsea_table_file)

# Get reduced GSEA table
gsea_reduced_table_file <- paste0("analysis_gsea/", cohort_id, ".gsea.full.reduced.csv")
gsea_reduced_table <- read_csv(gsea_reduced_table_file)

# Remove unnecessary columns
retain_cols <- c(
  "geneSet",
  "description",
  "test_group",
  "ref_group",
  "enrichmentScore",
  "normalizedEnrichmentScore",
  "size",
  "pValue",
  "FDR"
)
retain_cols_names <- c(
  "Gene Set ID",
  "Gene Set Description",
  "Test Group",
  "Reference Group",
  "Raw Enrichment Score",
  "Normalised Enrichment Score",
  "Gene Set Size",
  "p-value",
  "FDR-Adjusted p-value"
)

gsea_table <- gsea_table %>%
  select(all_of(retain_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
gsea_reduced_table <- gsea_reduced_table %>%
  select(all_of(retain_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

# Get all comparisons
unique_comparisons <- gsea_table %>%
  select(test_group, ref_group) %>%
  unique()
all_comparisons <- unique_comparisons %>%
  unite(comparison, test_group, ref_group, sep = " vs. ") %>%
  .$comparison
all_comparisons_str <- unique_comparisons %>%
  unite(comparison, test_group, ref_group, sep = "_vs_") %>%
  .$comparison
names(all_comparisons_str) <- all_comparisons

# Get GSEA plots
gsea_plots <- sapply(all_comparisons_str, function(cmp) {
  paste0("analysis_gsea/plots/", cohort_id, ".gsea.", cmp, ".png")
})
```

#### Dataset name: `{r} cohort_id`

#### All comparisons made:

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (cmp in all_comparisons) {
  cat("- ")
  cat(cmp)
  cat("\n")
}
```

### GSEA expression results

:::panel-tabset

```{r}
#| results: asis
purrr::walk(
  sort(all_comparisons),
  function(n) {
    p <- gsea_plots[[n]]
    cat(paste("####", n, "\n\n"))
    cat(paste("#####", "Gene Set Enrichment Analysis Results:", n))
    cat(paste0('<img src="', p, '" alt="gsea results: ', n, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
  }
)
```

:::
